abba-yosei-ben-dosai.name: Abba Yosei ben Dosai
abba-yosei-ben-dosai.bio: Tanna cited in baraitot, here reporting that Ben Azzai’s ruling on denied deposits concerned only the firstborn.
abba-yosei-ben-dosai.prompt: A sage in his 60s with a long grey beard and a plain undyed wool mantle, one finger raised as he corrects a report of another scholar’s words; background of limestone arches and olive trees in soft afternoon light.
